compiled_state.title: Enforce in prompt: agent does NOT populate checks{} block (deterministic post-processor owns it)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5 (074b): the agent does not populate the checks block (leaves the fields null or unset) so the deterministic post-processor owns those values exclusively
- dd-6 (074b): when the agent produces an item it expects to fail an sc-7 threshold, it populates rationale.deviations[] with {rule_id, reason} at authoring time; the reason field is authored by the LLM and is not synthesized by deterministic post-processing
- dd-7 (074b): unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Description
Add explicit forbidden-output rules to plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md prompt:
1. Agent MUST leave checks.fk_grade, checks.banned_words_found, checks.active_voice unset (or null) in produced YAML. These are computed by the deterministic post-processor (story 67c1).
2. When the agent expects an item to fail a closing-condition threshold (banned word present, passive voice, long sentences), it MUST populate rationale.deviations[] with {rule_id, reason} authored by the LLM.

Write a RED test fixture that dispatches gov-copy-writer with a sample Copy Needs section and asserts the produced artifact: (a) checks block fields are absent or null; (b) for an item with deliberately-problematic content, rationale.deviations[] contains a non-empty reason.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a sample Copy Needs section with one item containing a banned word and one normal item; When gov-copy-writer is dispatched and emits its artifact; Then the artifact YAML loads, each item's checks{} block fields are absent or null (deterministic post-processor will fill them later), AND the deliberately-problematic item carries rationale.deviations[] with a populated reason field.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Prompt forbids agent self-attestation of checks block
  Verify: grep -qE 'checks.*unset|do not populate.*checks|deterministic post-processor' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Prompt requires deviations.reason at authoring time
  Verify: grep -qE 'rationale\\.deviations|deviations\\[\\]' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Test fixture asserts checks block unset
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-gov-copy-writer-checks-isolation.sh
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-gov-copy-writer-checks-isolation.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
